description: The line plot, titled "Ablation Study on HateXplain Dataset," illustrates the performance of a model across five different configurations, with the y-axis representing the metric value in percentage (%) and the x-axis showing the model variant. The y-axis ranges from 58% to 66%, with major gridlines at 58, 60, 62, 64, and 66. The x-axis displays five distinct model configurations: "Full model (Ours)", "w/o Prompt", "w/o Augmentation", "w/o Attention", and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The legend indicates three metrics: Precision (purple line with circle markers), Recall (light blue line with circle markers), and F1-score (brown line with circle markers). For the "Full model (Ours)", all three metrics are high, with Precision at 65.45%, Recall at 65.78%, and F1-score at 65.56%. In the "w/o Prompt" configuration, all metrics drop significantly, with Precision at 61.06%, Recall at 59.64%, and F1-score at 60.16%. The "w/o Augmentation" configuration shows a recovery in performance, with Precision at 62.22%, Recall at 62.63%, and F1-score at 63.75%. In the "w/o Attention" configuration, Precision increases to 64.06%, while Recall drops to 59.17% and F1-score to 59.67%. Finally, in the "w/o Prompt & Augmentation" configuration, all metrics decline further, with Precision at 65.44%, Recall at 56.82%, and F1-score at 57.74%. The plot demonstrates that the full model performs best, and removing components like the prompt or augmentation leads to a significant drop in performance, while removing attention has a mixed effect.
